data.title: About Yu-Tzu Lin

children.text: Research · Practice · Education

Yu-Tzu Lin is an urban planner, educator and researcher based in Taiwan. She is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Finance, College of Business and Management, Chihlee University of Technology, and a PhD Candidate at the Faculty of Architecture and the Built Environment, Delft University of Technology.

Her academic background spans urban planning and land economics, including graduate training in urban planning at National Chung Hsing University and studies in Land Economics at National Chengchi University.

Her work focuses on urban regeneration, climate adaptation and resilience, disaster-prevention planning, land use and development, social housing, circular construction, public-private partnerships and comparative planning between Taiwan and the Netherlands.

data.excerpt: Urban planner, educator and researcher connecting academic inquiry with real-world planning practice.

data.title: 關於林育慈

children.text: 研究 · 實務 · 教育
林育慈是一位在臺灣工作的都市規劃師、教育者與研究者。她現任致理科技大學商務管理學院財務金融系助理教授，同時為荷蘭台夫特理工大學建築與建成環境學院博士候選人。
她的學術背景橫跨都市規劃與土地經濟，曾於國立中興大學接受都市規劃研究所訓練，並於國立政治大學修習地政學。
她的研究聚焦於都市再生、氣候調適與韌性、防災規劃、土地使用與開發、社會住宅、循環營建、公私協力夥伴關係，以及臺灣與荷蘭之間的比較規劃。
研究關懷
林育慈長期投入都市規劃、都市再生、氣候調適與都市防災、社會住宅及社區規劃等研究與實務工作，並關注生成式 AI 在場所營造、社區參與、都市分析與規劃教育中的應用。

data.title: Utrecht: Central Station Area Regeneration
data.excerpt: Reconnecting old and new districts, restoring the canal blue-green network and transforming a major transport hub.

$media.alt: Canal and historic urban area in the Netherlands

children.text: Reconnecting Old and New Districts

Utrecht Centraal station area represents one of Europe’s most ambitious urban regeneration initiatives (Stationsgebied). In the 1970s, urban planners filled the historic Catharijnesingel canal with concrete to build a multi-lane motorway. Decades later, the city took the bold decision to reverse this modernist mistake.
Restoring the Blue-Green Canal Network

By excavating the concrete highway and restoring the historic water ring around the old city, Utrecht not only reconnected historic waterways for boaters and wildlife, but also created high-value public spaces that cool the city and absorb stormwater.
Multimodal Transit and Cycling Super-Hub

Beneath the newly expanded station square sits the world’s largest bicycle parking facility with capacity for 12,500 bicycles. It seamlessly stitches together heavy rail, light rail, buses, and active mobility, setting a global benchmark for transit-oriented regeneration.

data.title: 烏特勒支：中央車站地區再生
data.excerpt: 重新連結新舊街區、恢復運河藍綠網絡，並轉型大型運輸樞紐。

$media.alt: Canal and historic urban area in the Netherlands

children.text: 重新連結新舊街區
烏特勒支中央車站地區（Stationsgebied）是歐洲最具雄心的都市再生計畫之一。1970 年代，規劃者為興建多線道高速公路，以混凝土填平了歷史悠久的 Catharijnesingel 運河。數十年後，這座城市大膽決定逆轉這項現代主義的錯誤。
恢復藍綠運河網絡
透過拆除混凝土高速公路並恢復老城環繞的歷史水環，烏特勒支不僅為船隻與野生動物重新連通了歷史水道，也創造出高價值的公共空間，為城市降溫並吸納雨水。
複合運輸與自行車超級樞紐
新擴建的車站廣場地下，設有全球最大的自行車停車設施，可容納 12,500 輛自行車。它將重軌、輕軌、公車與主動運輸無縫串接，為大眾運輸導向的都市再生樹立了全球標竿。

data.title: Barcelona: Planning Transformation & Green Urban Fabric
data.excerpt: From the nineteenth-century Cerdà grid to contemporary greening of the central city and Superblocks (Superilles).

$media.alt: Barcelona Eixample grid aerial architecture

children.text: From Cerdà’s Grid to Contemporary Living

Ildefons Cerdà’s 1859 Eixample plan established Barcelona’s world-famous octagonal street grid with chamfered corners, designed with egalitarian access to sunlight, ventilation, and green open courtyards.
Superblocks (Superilles) Revolution

In response to automobile dominance, noise, and air pollution, Barcelona introduced the Superblocks concept. By clustering 3x3 block grids, internal streets are restricted to pedestrian-priority shared spaces (10 km/h) with greenery, outdoor seating, and playgrounds, while perimeter streets absorb through-traffic.
Green Axes and Climate Shelters

The transformation of streets like Consell de Cent into Green Axes demonstrates how existing roadway asphalt can be converted into permeable, tree-lined civic corridors that combat the urban heat island effect and strengthen neighborhood cohesion.

data.title: 巴塞隆納：規劃轉型與綠色都市肌理
data.excerpt: 從十九世紀的塞爾達方格，到當代市中心綠化與超級街區（Superilles）。

$media.alt: Barcelona Eixample grid aerial architecture

children.text: 從塞爾達方格到當代生活
伊爾德豐斯・塞爾達（Ildefons Cerdà）1859 年的擴建區（Eixample）計畫，確立了巴塞隆納聞名世界的八角形切角街廓，設計理念是讓每個人都能平等取得陽光、通風與綠意盎然的開放中庭。
超級街區（Superilles）革命
面對汽車主導、噪音與空氣污染，巴塞隆納提出超級街區概念。將 3×3 的街廓組合成一個單元，內部街道限制為行人優先的共享空間（時速 10 公里），配置綠化、戶外座椅與遊戲場，外圍街道則承接通過性交通。
綠軸與氣候庇護所
將 Consell de Cent 等街道轉型為綠軸，顯示既有道路瀝青如何轉化為透水、林蔭密布的公共廊道，對抗都市熱島效應並強化鄰里凝聚力。

data.title: Vienna: Railway Brownfields & Social Housing
data.excerpt: Brownfield regeneration, livable districts and the evolution of Vienna’s world-renowned social-housing model.

$media.alt: Vienna urban architecture and public space

children.text: The Vienna Social Housing Model

Vienna is widely recognized as one of the world’s most livable cities, largely attributable to its centurylong commitment to social housing. Over 60% of the city’s population lives in municipal housing (Gemeindebauten) or subsidized cooperative housing.
Regenerating Railway Brownfields: Sonnwendviertel

The redevelopment of the former Südbahnhof rail freight yard into the new Central Station and adjacent Sonnwendviertel district created thousands of energy-efficient apartments surrounding the central Helmut-Zilk-Park, integrating schools, community facilities, and commercial ground floors.
Aspern Seestadt: Smart City Innovation

Aspern Seestadt, built on a former airfield, represents an urban laboratory for low-carbon living, 50/50 gender-equitable street naming and design, geothermal energy grids, and high-density subsidized housing for diverse socioeconomic backgrounds.

data.title: 維也納：鐵道棕地與社宅典範
data.excerpt: 棕地再生、宜居街區，以及維也納舉世聞名的社會住宅模式之演進。

$media.alt: Vienna urban architecture and public space

children.text: 維也納社會住宅模式
維也納被公認為全球最宜居的城市之一，這在很大程度上歸功於其長達一世紀的社會住宅承諾。全市超過 60% 的人口居住於市政住宅（Gemeindebauten）或補貼合作住宅。
鐵道棕地再生：索恩文德爾區（Sonnwendviertel）
將舊南站（Südbahnhof）貨運場改建為新中央車站與鄰近的索恩文德爾區，創造了數千戶節能住宅，環繞中央的 Helmut-Zilk 公園，並整合學校、社區設施與一樓商業空間。
阿斯彭湖城（Aspern Seestadt）：智慧城市創新
阿斯彭湖城建於舊機場之上，是低碳生活的都市實驗室，包含 50/50 性別平等的街道命名與設計、地熱能源網絡，以及服務多元社經背景的高密度補貼住宅。

data.title: Amsterdam: Cycling & Low-carbon Communities
data.excerpt: Human-centered mobility, ecological housing and low-carbon planning strategies.

$media.alt: Amsterdam canals and bicycle bridge

children.text: Evolution of Amsterdam’s Bicycle Infrastructure
Amsterdam’s cycling dominance is not a historical accident but the product of deliberate grassroots campaigning and urban planning policies starting from the 1970s Stop de Kindermoord movement.
Continuous Protected Networks

By prioritizing physically separated cycle tracks, grade-separated intersections, dedicated traffic signals, and traffic calming across residential streets, cycling became the quickest, safest, and most convenient mode of daily transit for all ages.
Circular Neighborhoods: Buiksloterham and IJburg

Across the IJ river, brownfield transformations like Buiksloterham demonstrate circular economy principles in urban regeneration, where soil remediation, bio-based construction materials, and local energy cooperatives shape a resilient urban future.

data.title: 阿姆斯特丹：自行車與低碳社區
data.excerpt: 以人為本的移動、生態住宅與低碳規劃策略。

$media.alt: Amsterdam canals and bicycle bridge

children.text: 阿姆斯特丹自行車基礎設施的演進
阿姆斯特丹的自行車優勢並非歷史偶然，而是源自 1970 年代「停止殺害孩童（Stop de Kindermoord）」運動，由基層倡議與都市規劃政策共同刻意推動的成果。
連續且受保護的網絡
藉由優先設置實體分隔的自行車道、立體分隔的路口、專用號誌，以及住宅街道的交通寧靜化，自行車成為各年齡層最快速、最安全、最便利的日常交通方式。
循環社區：Buiksloterham 與 IJburg
在 IJ 河對岸，Buiksloterham 等棕地轉型展現了都市再生中的循環經濟原則：土壤整治、生物基營建材料與在地能源合作社，共同塑造具韌性的都市未來。

data.title: Delft: Station-area Regeneration & Adaptive Reuse
data.excerpt: Railway land redevelopment and the reuse of historic academic architecture.

$media.alt: Historic Dutch city canal and modern architecture

children.text: The Spoorzone Delft Project

For decades, an elevated rail viaduct sliced through Delft, severing historic quarters from modern neighborhoods with constant noise and vibration. The Spoorzone project buried the four-track railway into a subterranean tunnel, freeing up valuable surface land.
Civic Integration: Station and City Hall

Designed by Mecanoo, the new station hall integrates the municipal government offices directly above the transit concourse. The vaulted ceiling features an historic 1877 map of Delft in ceramic blue tiles, bridging the city’s heritage with modern civic accessibility.
Adaptive Reuse on the TU Delft Campus

Alongside station redevelopment, TU Delft campus has led European practices in transforming historic academic buildings and botanical gardens into collaborative incubators and resilient public realms.

data.title: 台夫特：車站地區再生與適應性再利用
data.excerpt: 鐵道用地再開發與歷史學術建築的再利用。

$media.alt: Historic Dutch city canal and modern architecture

children.text: 台夫特 Spoorzone 計畫
數十年來，一座高架鐵路橋穿越台夫特，以持續的噪音與震動將歷史街區與現代鄰里切割開來。Spoorzone 計畫將四線鐵道埋入地下隧道，釋放出珍貴的地面土地。
公民整合：車站與市政廳
新車站大廳由 Mecanoo 設計，將市府辦公室直接整合於運輸大廳上方。拱形天花板以陶瓷藍磚呈現 1877 年的台夫特歷史地圖，將城市遺產與現代公民可及性相連結。
台夫特理工大學校園的適應性再利用
在車站再開發的同時，台夫特理工大學校園引領歐洲實務，將歷史學術建築與植物園轉化為協作孵化器與具韌性的公共領域。

data.title: Taiwan: Resilience, Housing & Community Planning
data.excerpt: Climate adaptation, disaster planning, social housing and AI-assisted community practice.

$media.alt: Taiwan landscape and urban scenery

children.text: Planning in an Era of Compound Risks

Taiwan faces high vulnerability to typhoons, extreme rainfall, earthquakes, and heat stress. Addressing these challenges requires integrating climate risk assessment directly into master spatial planning and neighborhood disaster-prevention networks.
Social Housing and Spatial Equity

Taiwan’s social housing program has expanded rapidly in recent years, evolving beyond basic sheltering toward neighborhood community catalysts that provide social welfare facilities, kindergartens, public open space, and circular construction standards.
AI-Assisted Community Planning

Emerging applications of generative AI provide powerful tools to bridge professional planners and community residents, democratizing 3D visualization, scenario testing, and participatory co-creation for neglected public lands.

data.title: 臺灣：韌性、社宅與社區實踐
data.excerpt: 氣候調適、防災規劃、社會住宅與 AI 輔助社區實踐。

$media.alt: Taiwan landscape and urban scenery

children.text: 複合風險時代的規劃
臺灣面臨颱風、極端降雨、地震與熱壓力的高度脆弱性。因應這些挑戰，需將氣候風險評估直接整合進空間總體規劃與鄰里防災網絡。
社會住宅與空間公平
近年臺灣的社會住宅計畫快速擴張，已從基本的庇護功能，演進為鄰里社區的催化者，提供社福設施、幼兒園、公共開放空間與循環營建標準。
AI 輔助社區規劃
生成式 AI 的新興應用，為專業規劃者與社區居民搭起強大的橋梁，使 3D 視覺化、情境測試與參與式共創對閒置公有地更加普及。

data.title: Jiangcui Green Boundary, Stone Rhythm Reborn: AI-empowered Community Planning and Place-making on Reserved Public Facility Land
data.excerpt: New Taipei City community planner programme; generative AI supports resident participation and the revitalisation of reserved public facility land. Project lead, 2025.

$media.alt: Community workshop and collaborative planning

children.text: Project Background: The Reserved Public Facility Land Dilemma

The New Taipei metropolitan area has long struggled with reserved public facility land that remains unacquired and undeveloped, leaving sites vacant, dilapidated and tangled in complex ownership. Using reserved land in Banqiao’s Jiangcui district as a pilot, this project explores how community planning mechanisms can give such spaces public value without a large land-acquisition budget.
Bringing Generative AI into Community Workshops

Traditional community workshops are often limited by residents’ difficulty in drawing spatial ideas. This project introduced generative AI image-translation tools that instantly turn residents’ spoken ideas for green paths, resting stones and pocket parks into realistic scenes, greatly improving how efficiently and how deeply residents build consensus.
Outcomes and Institutional Reflections

Residents reshaped the green boundary and stone landscape themselves and set up a long-term, self-managed maintenance mechanism. The work was presented at the 2026 international academic conference in Atlanta, showcasing Taiwan’s forward-looking results in AI-assisted community planning.

data.title: 江翠綠界・石韻新生：AI 賦能社區規劃與公保地場所營造
data.excerpt: 新北市社區規劃師實踐計畫；以生成式 AI 輔助民眾參與與公共設施保留地場所活化，計畫主持人（2025）。

$media.alt: Community workshop and collaborative planning

children.text: 計畫背景與公保地困境
新北市都會區長期面臨公共設施保留地未徵收開闢所衍生的閒置、窳陋及產權複雜等議題。本案以板橋江翠地區公保地為試點，探討如何在不涉及龐大土地徵收預算前提下，透過社區規劃機制賦予空間公共價值。
生成式 AI 導入社區參與工作坊
傳統社區工作坊常受限於民眾空間繪圖能力的門檻，本計畫創新導入生成式 AI 圖像轉譯工具，將在地居民對於綠意步道、休憩石韻、口袋公園的口述想法，即時轉化為高品質擬真場景圖，大幅提高居民凝聚共識的效率與共感。
實踐成果與制度性省思
透過民眾自主動手改造綠帶邊界與石材地景，建立社區自主維護長效管理機制，並發表於 2026 年亞特蘭大國際學術研討會，展現臺灣在 AI 輔助社區規劃的國際前瞻成果。

data.title: Social Housing Practice Guidelines: The Taipei Experience
data.excerpt: A four-volume book and e-book project; project lead and chief editor, 2021–2023. A systematic account of social housing planning, construction and management guidelines.

$media.alt: Modern architectural facade and housing development

children.text: A Systematic Review of Taipei’s Social Housing Journey

Since 2014, Taipei has pursued the large-scale construction of ten thousand social housing units, accumulating first-hand experience in land acquisition, community communication, mixed-use development and smart management. Yu-Tzu Lin served as project lead and chief editor of this commissioned study, drawing on two years of systematic interviews and literature compilation.
The Four-Volume Structure and Core Values

The guidelines span four volumes: Volume 1, Policy and Planning Thinking; Volume 2, Architectural Planning and Design Practice; Volume 3, Smart Buildings and Circular Construction Technology; Volume 4, Community Operation and Property Management Standards. They have become an important reference for governments at every level promoting social housing.

data.title: 臺北市社會住宅實踐指引 — 臺北經驗 (Social Housing Practice Guidelines)
data.excerpt: 四冊專書與電子書出版計畫；計畫主持人與總編輯（2021–2023）。系統性梳理社會住宅規劃、營造與經營指引。

$media.alt: Modern architectural facade and housing development

children.text: 系統化回顧臺北社會住宅推進歷程
自 2014 年起，臺北市大規模推動萬戶社會住宅興建，在土地取得、社區溝通、多目標使用、智慧化管理等方面累積了龐大的第一手實務經驗。本研究受託由林育慈擔任計畫主持人與總編輯，歷經兩年系統化訪談與文獻彙編。
四冊指引架構與核心價值
全套指引分為四冊，涵蓋：第一冊「政策與規劃思維」、第二冊「建築規劃與設計實務」、第三冊「智慧建築與循環營建技術」、第四冊「社區經營與物業管理準則」，成為各級政府推動社會住宅的重要參考典範。

data.title: Secure Homes, Better Housing: Integrated Urban Renewal Innovation Services in Taipei and New Taipei (USR)
data.excerpt: Ministry of Education University Social Responsibility programme; co-principal investigator, 2025–2027. Linking industry, government, academia and communities to advance integrated urban renewal and disaster resilience.

$media.alt: Urban renewal buildings and community

children.text: Ageing Buildings and Disaster Resilience in Greater Taipei

More than seventy percent of buildings in Taipei and New Taipei are over thirty years old. With an ageing population and seismic risk, urban renewal has become an unavoidable public-safety issue, yet information asymmetry and low trust are often the biggest obstacles to integration.
The University as a Neutral Third-party Integrator

Through the USR programme, the Chihlee University of Technology team, with Yu-Tzu Lin as co-principal investigator, combines financial analysis, regulatory consultation, architectural design and community communication expertise to offer neutral advice in local communities, helping owners understand rights-transformation mechanisms and build safe, secure living environments together.

data.title: 安心住好宅：雙北都更整合創新服務計畫 (USR)
data.excerpt: 教育部大學社會責任實踐計畫；共同主持人（2025–2027）。串聯產官學與社區推動都更整合與防災韌性。

$media.alt: Urban renewal buildings and community

children.text: 雙北高齡老屋與防災整合挑戰
雙北地區三十年以上老舊建築比例超過七成，伴隨人口高齡化與耐震防災風險，推動都市更新已成為不可忽視的公共安全課題。然而資訊不對稱與信任度不足往往是整合的最大瓶頸。
大學智庫作為中立整合第三方
致理科技大學團隊透過 USR 計畫，由林育慈副教授擔任共同主持人，結合財務分析、法規諮詢、建築設計與社區溝通專業，進入在地社區提供中立諮詢，協助地主釐清都更權利變換機制，共同營造安全安心的居住環境。
